mappingLimits.limit: L1-ENV-01 observes only the synthetic proposal/write boundary. Lifetime logs, protected records, operator override/stop and backup plans remain separate. Named competent oversight and instruction-following (deep09), and automation-bias training, displayed confidence/inputs and acceptance monitoring (deep10), are not established by refusing an agent write.

L1-ENV-04 is a pending P2-27 wrapper, not a parallel recall implementation. Supplier/customer traceability, withdrawal decisions and authority notification remain open. FF18/deep13 ask for FDA-request sortable KDE/CTE records within 24 hours, not recall completion within 24 hours; the independent records/export requirement and legal dates remain unverified and untested here.

L1-ENV-05 addresses configured timestamps, feed availability and numeric limits only. CCP/deviation/corrective-action human sign-off (FF1), and hazard analysis, CCP/OPRP selection and validation (FF11), remain open.

L1-ENV-06 tests a reference bound to the same lot only. Role-specific primary/downstream/trader duties, plot geolocation, deforestation and legality checks, eligible simplified declarations, supplier/recipient records and five-year retention remain manual/legal gaps. It does not require every operator to file its own statement.

A declared entity type does not establish CIP-002 categorisation of all hosts/tools/integrations. A declared domain does not establish safety-component classification, the authority to stop, an actual manual fallback or a tested safe state. Native facts do not carry asset class, numeric capacity, write access or hazard-reviewed safe-state configuration.

The full reporting drill remains pending. Existing F4 IDs nis2-23-4a-early-warning, nis2-23-4b-incident-notification and nis2-23-4d-final-report provide clock definitions/arithmetic only. The final deadline is one calendar month from incident notification, not 30 days from awareness. P2-30 L1-TECH-07 source is now integrated and supplies only a partial 24-hour synthetic drill; the grid profiles now declare Technology scope, but none of these profiles selects L1-TECH-07 under the current pack and jurisdiction filters, and vendor-risk, 72-hour and final-report delivery remain open.

The requested Article73 reporting drill has no Environment signature control here. Existing eu-ai-act-73-3-widespread is a conditional two-calendar-day clock from awareness, not proof that notices were produced or delivered. Applicability and exact current legal text need independent review; no seventh control or duplicated clock is added.

P2-30 L1-TECH-02 source is now integrated. The grid profiles now declare Technology scope, but no profile selects L1-TECH-02 as applicable under the current pack and jurisdiction filters, and its early-warning fixture cannot establish all CRA 24-hour/72-hour/final stages, Single Reporting Platform delivery, manufacturer scope or legal applicability. Composed-profile binding and the full reporting remainder remain pending.

Unmapped actual questions remain self-reported questionnaires capped at L1, including resilience and environmental-claim duties. Versioned MM4 energy-label/EPREL and UU9 ride-through questions retain their actual IDs; no retired unversioned question or nearby simulator coverage is invented.
